card.title: Plant Manager - Dairy Preferred
card.description:
**Confidential Search: ESL Processing Manager – Dairy Manufacturing** 
**Location:** Greater Philadelphia, PA Area 
**Industry:** Dairy / Food & Beverage Manufacturing 
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Onsite 
**Compensation:** Competitive Base + Bonus + Full Benefits 
**Confidential Role – Qualified candidates only will be contacted directly**

### **Position Summary**

A well-established dairy manufacturer in the Philadelphia region is conducting a confidential search for an experienced **ESL Processing Manager**. This role will oversee operations related to extended shelf life milk and dairy beverage processing, with a strong focus on product quality, plant performance, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience with **HTST, UHT, or ESL pasteurization systems**, a deep understanding of **fluid dairy processing**, and a proven ability to lead production teams in a **fast-paced, SQF-certified environment**.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead daily operations of the ESL processing department, ensuring product quality and production efficiency.
* Manage HTST/UHT equipment, CIP/SIP procedures, and aseptic processing protocols.
* Oversee batch formulation, temperature and flow controls, and compliance with state and federal regulations.
* Coordinate production schedules, sanitation cycles, and preventative maintenance in conjunction with QA and maintenance teams.
* Lead, train, and supervise ESL line operators and processing staff; enforce safety, GMP, and food safety practices.
* Monitor and improve KPIs related to yield, run efficiency, downtime, and loss.
* Collaborate with R&D, Quality Assurance, Packaging, and Distribution teams on process improvement initiatives.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of dairy or beverage processing experience, with at least 2 years in an ESL, HTST, or UHT operation.
* Strong understanding of fluid milk or dairy-based beverage production and regulatory compliance (FDA, PMO).
* Supervisory or leadership experience in a food manufacturing plant.
* Familiarity with CIP/SIP systems, flow schematics, and thermal processing validation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Experience working in SQF-certified or similar food safety environments.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with aseptic packaging lines or ESL bottled products.
* Pasteurizer or processing certifications (e.g., HACCP, SQF Practitioner).
* Knowledge of automation systems (e.g., PLCs, SCADA) used in fluid processing.

**To Apply Confidentially:** 
Please send your resume and brief cover note to **laws@henpencorp.com** 
Or text **408-755-5423** to express interest.

*Only qualified applicants with relevant dairy or ESL processing experience will be contacte*

card.title: Sr Manager Production- Chicago Bruss
card.description:
**Job Details:**

Summary: This position is responsible for supporting overall plant operations and performance, including controlling expenses, ensuring compliance with federal meat inspection, OSHA, food safety, and company requirements, and consistently interpreting and enforcing company policies. The position partners with HR and plant leadership to support effective Team Member and labor relations in a union environment, including adherence to the collective bargaining agreement. Responsibilities include assisting in determining staffing needs; maintaining accurate records and reports; effectively resolving operational issues with appropriate follow-up; and partnering with department leaders to achieve production, quality, yield, labor, cost, and performance goals. The position is also responsible for maintaining high standards in safety, sanitation, housekeeping, security, and food safety; leading, developing, evaluating, and coaching production leaders; overseeing designated shift operations; and performing other responsibilities as assigned by the Plant Manager.

 

REQUIREMENTS:

 

Education:

High School diploma with equivalent experience or college degree preferred.

 

Experience:

5 plus years of related industry; 5 plus years supervisory experience in a meat processing facility pork or beef preferred ; and knowledge of OSHA USDA and HAACP regulations.

 

Computer Skills:

Standard computer skills.

 

Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Must be capable of communicating well both verbally and in writing with all levels of Team Members from hourly to upper management as well as government officials.

 

Special Skills:

Leader problem solver team player.

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Manage subordinate General Foreman supervisors who supervise team members in the plant; carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws; interview hire and train team members; plan assign and direct work; monitor and appraise work performance; reward, coach, counsel, and discipline team members; address complaints and resolve problems.

 

Travel:

0-20

 

Other Requirements:

Lead people by example, accept and delegate responsibility, display sound judgment and decision-making skills; problem solve in an efficient manner with sound follow up; strong managerial skills necessary; excellent safety and attendance records. Ability to work with department leaders to meet safety production and quality yields and meet goals. All Tyson Team Members are responsible for safety. This includes but is not limited to personal safety and food safety. This position is responsible for food safety food quality and legality.

 
 

Must attach a resume for consideration.

 
 

This position is slated for candidates who are currently working at this facility and displaced team members. Priority consideration will be provided to these applicants first. If local Team Members are not selected, external candidates will then be reviewed for consideration.

 
All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

No

**Work Shift:**

A Shift (United States of America)

**Pay Range/Rate:**

**Incentives:**

Annual Incentive Plan:

No

Long-Term Incentive Plan:

No

**Certain roles at Tyson require background checks. If you are offered a position that requires a background check you will be provided additional documentation to complete once an offer has been extended.**

Any listed amounts represent the base pay range. Additional compensation may be available for this position based on various factors such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonuses. Pay is just one part of Tyson’s total compensation package.

 
 

***Tyson will develop an offer based on a candidate's or team member’s relevant skills and capabilities, the market data for the role described in this requisition, internal equity, and other information relevant to the candidate and role.***

 

Hourly Applicants ONLY -You must complete the task after submitting your application to provide additional information to be considered for employment.

 
 

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

 
 

Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

 
 

**CCPA Notice. If you are a California resident, and would like to learn more about what categories of personal information we collect when you apply for this job, and how we may use that information, please read our CCPA Job Applicant Notice at Collection****.**

card.title: Rendering Plant Manager
card.description:
UniSea is looking for an experienced Rendering Plant Manager to lead and manage operations of UniSea’s fish rendering plant in Dutch Harbor, Alaska. The Rendering Plant Manager will be working at our Dutch Harbor, Alaska operations.

The Rendering Plant Manager is responsible for managing all elements of production of Fish Meal, Bone Meal, Fish Oil, and other by-products at UniSea’s Meal Plant to achieve continuous operations and maximum profitability. Maintain efficient operations of Main Sump operation in compliance with all State and Federal requirements.

**Essential Duties**

1) Organize and manage production staff and manage activities of the Meal Plant processing operation and maintain operational performance of equipment in the Main Sump. Coordinate production based on G1 and G2 operations.

2) Work with the Maintenance department in proposing and making design changes in processing facilities and equipment to maximize plant efficiency. Submit work orders to maintain proper repair of processing facility on repair or installation work that the Meal Plant does not perform.

3) Counsel and train employees according to UniSea policies and procedures. Coach and motivate employees to achieve maximum performance and maintain high morale. Evaluate employee performance and take necessary steps to assist employees in improving performance. Administer discipline to employees as appropriate, including terminations.

4) Recommend capital equipment needs, methods of improvement, and tools and materials to maintain and improve competitive production efficiency.

5) Maintain knowledge about internal and external influences affecting the future of the industry and company.

6) Review and assure the accuracy of scale reports, production reports, shipping tallies, inventories and quality control reports.

7) Coordinate with machinery manufacturers in updating current technology as appropriate.

8) Assist safety personnel and promote good safety and hygiene procedures throughout the plant.

9) Maintain open communication with the Quality Assurance department to ensure product specification, micro, and labeling requirements are maintained.

10) Perform other duties as directed.

**Position Requirements**

· High School or equivalent is required.

· Vocational education in a skilled trade like Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, or Welding is preferred.

· Must have a minimum of 6 years of experience working in a rendering plant.

· Must have 2 years of experience in managing and supervising employees.

· Must have excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.

· Must be able and willing to work in a rendering plant and supervise employees’ work performance in the plant.

· Working proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Teams.

· Must be able to pass a post offer drug screen and criminal background check.

**This is a salaried exempt position located in Dutch Harbor, Alaska with a starting salary within the range of $96,754 - $116,122 per year.**

UniSea offers a rich benefits package including:

- Free company provided housing and utilities for employees in Dutch Harbor, Alaska.

- Free meals for employees in the company galley. Discounted meals are available for family members living in Alaska.

- Annual travel allowance benefit

- Relocation assistance

- Medical/Dental/Vision insurance available after 60-day eligibility period is satisfied

- A variety of different voluntary coverages are offered – including AFLAC policies and additional life insurance for self and family members

- Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Accounts are available after 60-day eligibility period is satisfied

- 401(k) plan and additional 3% employer contribution – after 6-month eligibility period is satisfied. UniSea matches 100% of your contributions up to the first 5%, plus makes an additional 3% employer contribution.

- Employer paid life insurance

- Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays

UniSea is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Pay: $96,754.00 - $116,122.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* rendering plant: 6 years (Required)
* Supervising: 2 years (Required)

Ability to Relocate:

* Dutch Harbor, AK 99692: Relocate with an employer provided relocation package (Required)

Work Location: In person

card.title: Director, Site Operations
card.description:
**The Role**
------------

The Director, Site Operations leads all aspects of our plant operations ranging from the cultivation of cannabis through distribution and everything in between. As the Director, Site Operations, you'll direct all the daily processes and long-term targets for the facility. You'll grind away at the details of managing internal resources to maximize safety, compliance, efficiency, productivity and culture. You'll also blaze the path toward creating and developing the multilevel professional team, and you'll work closely with your management team to keep every detail of the facility up to standards.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

* Oversee all strategic planning and vision for facility plant operations for cultivation, processing, packaging, maintenance, quality and logistics/fulfillment
* Manager all facility activities working closely with departmental managers ensuring wholesale objectives are accomplished on time and budget
* Own the facility budget; Analyze facility data, including efficiency metrics, labor variance analysis, defect rates, cost drivers, volume and capacity planning, etc. to make recommendations on optimal quality and efficiency improvements and capital expenditures
* Develop and produce reporting to clearly illustrate the trends of the business
* Manage and maintain a company culture consistent with the culture established at Green Thumb corporate of accountability, transparency and enjoyment
* Participate in developing and implementing rules, regulations, policies, and procedures to advance Green Thumb's mission, vision, goals and objectives
* Continuously improve the skills, knowledge and morale of all employees; create an environment where the entire team does the same
* Implement and maintain wholesale facility and equipment preventative maintenance program; replace, or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal billing or licensing requirements
* Will be required to be on-call and to respond to emergency situations at any time. This may include scheduling issues, potentially covering a vacant shift, facility issues and/or human resources requirements
* Other duties as assigned

**Safety & Compliance**
-----------------------

* Be aware of hazards in the workspace.
* Retain and understand department specific training.
* Be compliant with area safety requirements, state regulations and PPE requirements while at GTI sites.
* Follow GMP, biosecurity, sanitation or other quality and compliance requirements.
* Perform record keeping accurately and completely as directed by a lead or supervisor.
* Report and escalate safety & quality concerns.

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform reaching, grasping, bending, stooping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment
* Work involves daily exposure to allergens (such as cannabis, tree nuts, and coconut oil).
* Travel up to 10% may be required

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Business required; MBA or similar preferred
* 10+ years of management experience in manufacturing environment; direct management of 100+ individuals in a manufacturing setting required
* Consumer Packaged Good experience required
* In-depth knowledge & understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, certifications a plus
* Exposure to horticulture and/or plant science and/or lab processing, a plus
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience managing a P&L required
* Can-do attitude and ability to adapt quickly; business is experiencing tremendous growth so previous operational experience in growth environment is substantially preferred
* Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgement, common sense and resourcefulness
* Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment
* Possesses a high level of critical thinking
* Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information
* Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb
* Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations and passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* Must be at a minimum of 21 years of age.
* Must possess valid state ID.
* Must be able to obtain, and maintain, state badging requirements to work in the cannabis industry (requires background check and state review)

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**We're Hiring: Director of Operations | Poolwerx**

Are you a strategic operational leader passionate about driving franchise success and organic sales growth? Poolwerx is looking for a dynamic Director of Operations to lead our field operations team, coach franchise partners, and champion operational excellence across our network.

**About the Role**

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director of Operations develops and coordinates the efforts of the Operations team. You will deliver high-value support service spanning business coaching, leadership, salesmanship, and operational execution—all while fostering a positive brand and sales culture among our Franchise Partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Drive Growth:** Deliver planned organic sales growth projections for franchise partners and regions while optimizing tracking, measurement, and reward systems.
* **Network Expansion:** Partner with franchise development to facilitate the introduction of new partners, stores, and acquisition opportunities.
* **Leadership & Team Management:** Manage and empower Field Operations, Franchise Business Coaches (FBCs), Onboarding Specialists, Technical Trainers, and Customer Experience Teams.
* **Technical & Field Excellence:** Lead Technical Trainers to ensure technicians master cleaning, maintenance, service, and repair standards; spend time in-field conducting site visits with partners.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Commercial (B2B), Supply Chain, and Marketing teams to unlock local and regional growth opportunities.
* **Operational Alignment & Innovation:** Act as Operations Advisor for Innovation/Evolution programs to drive standard practices across the entire network.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Education:** Undergraduate degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* **Experience:** Extensive field or sales management experience in a franchise, multi-site, or retail environment (pool industry experience highly desired).
* **Financial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with proven ability to analyze and report on P&L and manage departmental budgets.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient with Google Workspace, MS Office, CRM systems, and modern business improvement platforms.
* **Communication & Mindset:** Strong, influential communicator with a proactive, resilient, and collaborative "can-do" attitude.

**How to Apply**

If you're ready to take your leadership career to the next level with a growing industry leader, submit your application today or reach out directly to learn more!

Pay: $140,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Farmers Brnch, TX 75244

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Overview**

The Operations Director will play a critical leadership role in the transformation and growth of Sterling Pharmaceutical Services. This individual must be a results-driven leader capable of accelerating operational excellence, strengthening organizational accountability, and improving financial performance while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and safety. The successful candidate will possess a strong sense of urgency, a hands-on leadership style, and a demonstrated track record of leading operational improvements, driving profitability, and delivering measurable results during periods of significant change and growth. The Operations Director will partner closely with executive leadership and regularly communicate progress, strategy, and performance metrics to key stakeholders, including ownership and the Board of Directors.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational and organizational initiatives to improve profitability, cash flow, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and execute strategic plans that align operational performance with company financial objectives.
* Establish a culture of accountability, urgency, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Identify, prioritize, and implement operational efficiencies that reduce costs and improve margins.
* Drive cross-functional execution against key business objectives and recovery plans.
* Monitor and report operational metrics to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
* Prepare and deliver presentations to executive leadership, Board members, lenders, investors, and external stakeholders.
* Partner closely with the CEO and COO to develop operational strategies and communicate progress against strategic initiatives.
* Lead change management efforts and effectively manage resistance during transformation initiatives.
* Ensure rapid decision-making and execution while maintaining compliance, quality, and safety standards.

**Requirements**

* B.S. in Engineering or Science discipline
* 10+ years of Operations Leadership experience. GMP aseptic manufacturing experience a plus.
* Demonstrated experience leading business transformation, operational turnarounds, restructurings, or significant performance improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, cost reduction programs, EBITDA improvement, and working capital initiatives.
* Experience presenting to Boards of Directors, private equity firms, investors, lenders, or ownership groups.
* Track record of building high-performing teams and holding leaders accountable to performance metrics.
* Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.

**Additional Information**

* Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Sterling Pharmaceutical Services does not sponsor employment visas now or in the future for this position.
* Relocation assistance is not available for this role. Candidates should reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the facility or be willing to relocate at their own expense.
* Sterling Pharmaceutical Services is conducting this search directly and is not engaging external recruiting or search firms for this position. We respectfully request that agencies and recruiters refrain from contacting us regarding candidate submissions.

Pay: $140,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
